newsitem.title: UK: S&P assigns A claims-paying to CIGNA Insurance Co.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A claims-paying to CIGNA Insurance Co.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it assigned its A claims-paying ability rating to CIGNA Insurance Co of Europe SA-NV (CIGNA Europe).
CIGNA Europe is a Belgium-based medium-szed non-life insurer, and is ultimately owned by CIGNA Corp U.S. (senior debt A minus), S&P said in a statement.
S&P listed the following positive rating factors.
- CIGNA Europe's strategic importance to its ultimate parent, CIGNA Corp.
- Its diversified and well balanced business mis.
- Its firm commitment to sustainable profitability.
- Going forward, the company's favourable earning prospects.

"Offsetting factors include CIGNA Europe's modest risk-based capital adequacy and the fact that the new strategies adopted since 1992 have yet to be tested in an unfavourable trading environment," said S&P.

"CIGNA Europe will build on its expertise in accident and health business, and its strong borderless coverage advantage, giving rise to average annual permium growth of around eight to 10 percent during the next five years," the agency said.
"Earnings will decline somewhat going forward, but the combined ratio is not expected to exceed the 100 percent level by more than a few percentage points," S&P said.
"CIGNA Europe's targeted return on equity of 15 percent will prove a realistic long-term goal, but will be difficult to consistently achieve throughout the current downturn."
S&P said risk-based capital would remain modest, yet adequate.
